purpose: Overview requirements for doc-link: goals, glossary, scope, responsibility boundaries, non-functional requirements, errors, and the decision and open-issue registers.
summary: Purpose and background: replacing DocAdvisor with permanent document-ID based indexing, reference tracking and change-impact notification
Overall system flow diagram covering introduction, DLID check and assignment, link check, ToC build and impact check
Document search flow with ToC rebuild confirmation and searching an existing ToC
Glossary of terms such as DLID, document ID, section ID, ToC, content hash and project management AI
Scope: what is included and excluded, and the responsibility boundary between doc-link and the project management AI
Non-functional requirements: rebuild consistency, determinism, idempotence, write boundary, diagnosability, resumability, scalability, generation limits
Error conditions and findings that do not block ToC finalization
Decision register D-001 to D-058 and the resolved open-issue table
